data.one_liner: AppLovin MAX Flutter plugin for Android and iOS
data.what_it_does: Integrates the AppLovin MAX SDK into Flutter applications for Android and iOS. Supports displaying interstitial ads, rewarded ads, banners, and MRECs.
use_when: You want to monetize your mobile app using AppLovin MAX ads.
Your app needs to display banners, MRECs, interstitial, or rewarded ads on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You are using ad networks other than AppLovin MAX and do not want to use AppLovin mediation.
You target web or desktop platforms, as this plugin only supports Android and iOS.
strengths: Provides official support for AppLovin MAX ad formats in Flutter.
Supports interstitial, rewarded, banner, and MREC ads with continuous SDK updates.
weaknesses: Limited platform support restricted to Android and iOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires integrating native AppLovin Android and iOS SDKs and configuring integration steps as detailed in the documentation.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Google AdMob/Ad Manager instead of AppLovin MAX for monetization.
